subject: PolarCare pilot — pricing slate, invoice draft, and next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@polarcare.ai>, Ali Khatri <ali.khatri@polarcare.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 14:10:00 -0800
Subject: PolarCare pilot — initial pricing slate & attached estimate

Hi Emma / Ali,

Thanks again for the call earlier — helpful to understand your two primary flows (patient triage chat + batch summarization for charting) and the mix of short/long sequences. Per our discussion I pulled together an initial cost slate and a draft invoice so you can see a concrete path to pilot. Attachments: polarcare_cost_model_v1.xlsx (breaks down unit economics) and polarcare_invoice_draft_v1.pdf (3-month pilot invoice).

Quick summary (top-level):
- Estimated monthly token volume: ~120M tokens (combination of 3M short-chat sessions + 0.6M longer summarization calls)
- Baseline target unit: $/1M input+output tokens — we can start at $900 / 1M for the pilot with quantization and batching options (see sheet)
- Pilot proposal: 3 months, fixed-price $45,000 (covers up to 360M tokens total across pilot months; overage billed monthly)
- Production pricing (post-pilot, committed): tiered bands with volume discount to $650 / 1M above 2B tokens annually (draft in model)

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Confirm the 120M tokens/mo estimate or give a 2-week range (low / expected / high).
2) Tell us if procurement needs a PO + preferred invoice recipient and billing address.
3) Let us know whether you want the pilot to include Dedicated (reserved GPU) or start on Hosted API — I recommend Hosted for fastest start, Dedicated if you need isolation and predictable latency.

Notes on economics (see cost model tab):
- Unit price target of $900 / 1M assumes Llama-3-family open model with 4-bit quantization + KV cache and a 10–12 token average response length.
- If you expect longer average responses (200+ tokens), the $/1M moves ~+25–40% unless we tune batching.
- We included estimated infra credits in the draft invoice to accelerate evaluation.

I left line-item comments in the spreadsheet for the quantization options and the breakdown between compute vs. storage/cache costs. If you want, I can run a quick sensitivity (two scenarios: conservative 180M/mo and aggressive 240M/mo) and push a final PDF by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference.com | +1 415-555-0187

Attachments:
- polarcare_cost_model_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 86 KB)
- polarcare_invoice_draft_v1.pdf (PDF, 45 KB)

From: Emma Li <emma.li@polarcare.ai>

Cc: Ali Khatri <ali.khatri@polarcare.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PolarCare pilot — initial pricing slate & attached estimate

Thanks Ben — appreciate the quick follow-up and the model. A few clarifying Qs from our side before we loop procurement: 

1) Can you confirm the $/1M figure by quant level? Specifically we care about (a) 4-bit (your recommended pilot), (b) 8-bit FP16 fallback, and (c) a mixed mode you mentioned where long-form summarization runs on a heavier config.
2) Our rough internal estimate is ~120M tokens/month baseline and a peak scenario at 220–250M/month. For budgeting we were thinking $100k–$200k annual run-rate post pilot. Is the tiered discount path you listed compatible with that runway?
3) Procurement will need a draft SOW and PO info. Can you send billing address + remit info on the invoice draft so the PO team can prep?

If you can answer the quant pricing and send a one-line PO-ready invoice with remit address, we can move this to procurement this week.

—Emma
Emma Li | Head of Product Integrations, PolarCare
emma.li@polarcare.ai | +1 212-555-0149

Marissa / Rishi — forwarding Emma's reply. Key asks:
- Provide quantized price breaks (4-bit / 8-bit / mixed) that we can commit to for a 3-month pilot. Emma also flagged procurement timelines (wants PO this week).
- Their baseline is ~120M tokens/mo; peak 220–250M. They budget ~$100k–$200k ARR post-pilot.

My suggestion: propose pilot unit at $850 / 1M for 4-bit (promotional pilot rate) with a defined uplift for 8-bit at +30% and mixed-mode at +45%. Keep the pilot invoice at $45k for 3 months and ensure the invoice has our remit address and the standard SOW stub. If we offer a commitment band at 1.5B tokens/year we can move to $700 / 1M after pilot.

Can you draft a one-line PO-ready invoice and the quant pricing table? I'm happy to be on the procurement call later this week.

—Ben

- Overage logic: pilot covers up to 360M total tokens; monthly overage priced at the 4-bit pilot rate.
